data.name: AtTimeZoneNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support the 'AT TIME ZONE' SQL construct.

data.name: AzureSqlOptionsNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support Azure SQL options. Use 'UseVistaDB' instead.

data.name: AzureSynapseOptionsNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support Azure Synapse options. Use 'UseVistaDB' instead.

data.name: ComputedColumnsNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support computed columns. Property '{property}' on entity '{entityType}' uses 'HasComputedColumnSql'.

data.name: CteNotSupported
data.value: The query would require a CTE ('WITH ... AS'), which VistaDB does not support. Try restructuring the query, or split it into multiple queries.

data.name: DateDiffBigNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support 'DATEDIFF_BIG'. Use 'DATEDIFF' with a sufficiently small unit instead.

data.name: DateFromPartsNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support 'DATEFROMPARTS' / 'DATETIMEFROMPARTS' SQL functions.

data.name: ExtendedPropertiesNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support extended properties (sp_addextendedproperty).

data.name: FullTextSearchNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support full-text search (CONTAINS / FREETEXT).

data.name: MemoryOptimizedTablesNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support memory-optimized tables.

data.name: MergeNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support the 'MERGE' statement.

data.name: WindowFunctionsNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support SQL window functions (e.g. 'ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ...)'). The query EF Core would emit uses one — typically because of a split-collection or paginated-collection translation. Restructure the query to avoid window functions, or split it into multiple round-trips.

data.name: OutputClauseNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support the SQL 'OUTPUT' clause.

data.name: SchemasNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support schemas. Entity type '{entityType}' is mapped to schema '{schema}'. Move it to the default schema (or omit 'HasDefaultSchema' / 'ToTable(..., schema)').

data.name: SequencesNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support sequences. Use IDENTITY columns instead.

data.name: SqlVariantNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support the 'sql_variant' data type.

data.name: StoredProceduresNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support stored procedures.

data.name: StructuralJsonNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support the SQL Server structural JSON type.

data.name: TemporalTablesNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support temporal (system-versioned) tables. Entity type '{entityType}' is configured as temporal.

data.name: UdtNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support user-defined CLR types (UDTs).

data.name: VectorTypeNotSupported
data.value: VistaDB does not support the SQL Server 'vector' data type.
